from PIL import Image
import numpy as np
for n in ['obs_0101','obs_0102']:
    im=np.array(Image.open('observations/%s.png'%n).convert('RGB')).astype(int)
    R,G,B=im[:,:,0],im[:,:,1],im[:,:,2]
    blue=(B>140)&(B-R>60)&(B-G>40)
    ys,xs=np.nonzero(blue)
    print(n,'vase u',xs.min(),xs.max(),'v',ys.min(),ys.max(),'uc',(xs.min()+xs.max())/2)
    brown=(R>70)&(R<175)&(G>25)&(G<100)&(B<80)&(R-B>40)&(R-G>25)
    ys2,xs2=np.nonzero(brown)
    if len(xs2): print('  brown u',xs2.min(),xs2.max(),'v',ys2.min(),ys2.max())
    # floor(wall junction: find per-column topmost floor pixel (tan/gray floor)
    fl=(abs(R-G)<25)&(R>120)&(R<190)&(G>110)&(B>90)&(B<165)&(R-B>15)
    tops=[]
    for u in range(0,512,16):
        c=np.nonzero(fl[:,u])[0]
        tops.append((u,c.min() if len(c) else None))
    print('  floortop',tops)
" 2>/dev/null
